verdict.rationale: Exa documents work that runs in the background without supervision. Its pricing page lists "Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web" and async deep research, list building, and enrichment. Exa Agent is described as an async research agent API, and Websets search, verify, and enrich automatically, delivering results asynchronously via the dashboard, API, or webhooks with real-time HTTP callbacks. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on configuring scheduled or recurring monitors (cadence, triggers, management), and independent or hands-on confirmation that scheduled automations work as described.
